# Jaai and ArcticQuests

> Portfolio for Jaai, a modder.

## About

Jaai contributes to Minecraft projects with their teams and works primarily with Java,
Fabric, and occasional Python tooling. The portfolio also covers open source documentation,
web development, and ArcticQuests studio work.

## Project sources

- [Projects](https://arcticquests.dev/#projects): Project contributions and studio work.
- [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/JaaiDead): Live Minecraft project listings and downloads.
- [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/members/jaaidead/projects): CurseForge project listings.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/JaaiDead): Source code and open source work.
- [Contact](https://arcticquests.dev/#contact): Gmail, Discord, GitHub, Modrinth, and CurseForge links.
- [Privacy](https://arcticquests.dev/privacy): Privacy policy.

## Keywords

Modder, Fabric, Java, Python, Modrinth, CurseForge, GitHub, ArcticQuests,
SplashOminous, Items Displayed, Nether's Exorcism, The Bygone, open source, web development.
